requirement_snapshot.name: Notes List
requirement_snapshot.description: Display a notes area on the home page with the heading "Notes" listing notes from the database via a GET /api/notes endpoint. Each note row shows its title. An empty state says "No notes yet." when the table has no rows.

interfaces.name: App
interfaces.responsibility: Express app entry that registers the notes router under /api/notes, additively wired at the established route registration mount point.
interfaces.specification: app.use('/api/notes', notesRouter) registered after /api/health; notesRouter imported from ./routes/notes; existing static/SPA handling untouched.
interfaces.test_focus: supertest GET /api/notes returns 200 with { notes: [...] } on the real app

interfaces.name: NotesTable
interfaces.responsibility: Idempotent CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notes (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, title TEXT NOT NULL) added to the shared init lifecycle.
interfaces.specification: Table `notes` with id and non-null title exists after initializeDatabase(); created via CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS so schema evolution stays idempotent.
interfaces.test_focus: harness setup creates notes table; rows readable via db_runtime helpers

interfaces.name: NotesRepo
interfaces.responsibility: DB access layer for notes: listNotes returns all note rows ordered by id; seedDefaultNotes inserts default titles only when the table is empty.
interfaces.specification: listNotes(): Promise<Array<{id:number,title:string}>> via all('SELECT id, title FROM notes ORDER BY id ASC'). seedDefaultNotes(tx?): idempotent insert of default titled notes when table has no rows.
interfaces.test_focus: integration: empty table returns []; seeded rows returned ordered by id

interfaces.name: SeedDb
interfaces.responsibility: Shared seed entrypoint extended to call seedDefaultNotes inside its transaction so default titled notes exist after normal startup/reset.
interfaces.specification: seedDatabase() runs seedDefaultNotes({run,get,all,exec}) inside withTransaction; deterministic and idempotent so empty-state seeding still works.
interfaces.test_focus: seeding twice yields identical rows; seeded titles visible through listNotes

interfaces.name: Notes
interfaces.responsibility: Express router for GET /api/notes that delegates to notes_repo.listNotes and responds with the JSON payload.
interfaces.specification: GET / responds 200 with body { notes: Array<{id:number,title:string}> } ordered by id; errors forwarded to next(error) for the central handler.
interfaces.test_focus: supertest: empty DB -> { notes: [] }; seeded DB -> titled rows in id order

interfaces.name: Notes
interfaces.responsibility: Frontend API client exposing fetchNotes() that GETs /notes through the shared axios apiClient and returns the note list.
interfaces.specification: fetchNotes(): Promise<Note[]> via apiClient.get<NotesResponse>('/notes') returning data.notes; Note = {id:number, title:string}.
interfaces.test_focus: unit with mocked apiClient: resolves notes array from { notes: [...] }

interfaces.name: NotesSection
interfaces.responsibility: Home-page notes area: section headed with the exact literal `Notes` listing one row per note title, with loading/error and the exact empty-state literal `No notes yet.`.
interfaces.specification:
Renders

Notes

; when notes empty and not loading renders exact text `No notes yet.`; otherwise
    with each note title; fetch error surfaced via role=alert. No hardcoded sample rows.
interfaces.test_focus: RTL: heading `Notes`; seeded titles rendered as rows; empty -> `No notes yet.`; error -> alert

interfaces.name: useNotes
interfaces.responsibility: State hook owning the notes fetch lifecycle: notes, loading, error, and reload, calling fetchNotes on mount.
interfaces.specification: Returns { notes: Note[], loading: boolean, error: string|null, reload: () => void }; fetch runs on mount via useEffect; empty result leaves notes as [].
interfaces.test_focus: RTL hook test: success populates notes; empty -> notes []; failure sets error and clears loading

interfaces.name: HomePage
interfaces.responsibility: Home page mount point extended additively to render NotesSection inside its existing layout container.
interfaces.specification: HomePage renders <NotesSection /> inside the max-w-7xl container; existing shell lines untouched; route registration in App.tsx unchanged.
interfaces.test_focus: RTL: rendering HomePage shows the `Notes` heading and empty state (or note titles via mocked fetch)
